(actor outer_when
  (interface (input request) (input allow) (input datain (width 3)) (input other (width 3)) (output seen (width 3)) (output done))
  (proc choose (params (c (width 1)) (v (width 3)) (alt (width 3)) (out dst (width 3))) (cond (c (set dst v)) (else (set dst alt))))
  
  (transaction main (on request) (when request (call choose allow datain other seen)) (complete done)))
